scope.incomplete_future_windows: exclude when the full horizon would reach development_end_exclusive

episode_event.source: closed 1h bars resampled causally from canonical 1m data
episode_event.regime: frozen classify_regime using EMA(25/99), five-bar slopes, ADX(14)>=20, ATR-percentile<0.9, and confirmed 1h structure HH_HL or LH_LL
episode_event.onset: first closed 1h bar whose state is TREND_UP or TREND_DOWN when the preceding eligible closed 1h state is not the same trend direction
episode_event.end: last consecutive closed 1h bar in that identical trend state
episode_event.anchor_timestamp: onset 1h close_time_ms + 1; all features use bars with close_time_ms <= onset close_time_ms
episode_event.secondary_unit: closed continuation bars clustered by episode_id

frozen_features.macro_4h_aligned: frozen macro_aligned on the latest closed 4h features at onset: LONG close>EMA25>EMA99 with EMA25 slope>0 and EMA99 slope>=0; SHORT exact mirror
frozen_features.structure_15m_aligned: latest closed 15m frozen confirmed-pivot structure is HH_HL for LONG or LH_LL for SHORT; pivot_left=2 and pivot_right=2, so only pivots confirmed by the anchor are visible
frozen_features.rsi_15m_aligned: latest closed 15m RSI(14) is in frozen LONG [45,72] or SHORT [28,55] range
frozen_features.roc_15m_aligned: latest closed 15m ROC(12)>0 for LONG or <0 for SHORT

future_labels.signed_close_return_atr: LONG=(future close-reference)/onset ATR; SHORT=(reference-future close)/onset ATR
future_labels.mfe_mae: nonnegative direction-aware favorable and adverse extremes divided by onset ATR
future_labels.holdout_firewall: the read ends before development_end_exclusive and every complete label requires anchor+horizon < development_end_exclusive

permutation.construction: within each year and onset 1h ATR decile, deterministically permute LONG/SHORT labels using seed 36; observed label multiset and frequency in every stratum are preserved
permutation.comparison: real direction signed return minus signed return under permuted direction

matched_opposite.selection: nearest absolute anchor time, earlier anchor tie-break, control reuse allowed
matched_opposite.comparison: candidate future raw path scored in candidate direction minus matched opposite episode future path scored in its own frozen regime direction

h14_nulls.bootstrap: episode-cluster resampling with replacement, 2000 simulations, seed 36, p05/p50/p95

increment_matching.H15_macro: aligned vs not aligned at episode onset; same year, direction and 1h ATR decile; K=1 nearest time with >=24h separation
increment_matching.H16_structure: confirmed structure aligned vs non-confirming/inconsistent; same year, direction and 1h ATR decile; K=1 nearest time with >=24h separation
increment_matching.H17_rsi: RSI aligned vs non-aligned; same year, direction and 1h ATR decile; K=1 nearest time with >=24h separation
increment_matching.H17_roc: ROC aligned vs non-aligned; same year, direction and 1h ATR decile; K=1 nearest time with >=24h separation
increment_matching.H17_both: both RSI+ROC aligned vs not-both; same year, direction and 1h ATR decile; K=1 nearest time with >=24h separation
increment_matching.delta: median(aligned)-median(matched non-aligned), except reach metrics use rate difference

direction_ladder.D2: D1 AND frozen confirmed 15m structure aligned
direction_ladder.D3: D2 AND frozen RSI and ROC both aligned
direction_ladder.selection_hierarchy: If H14 is not SUPPORTED choose NONE. Otherwise start D0 and add D1, D2, then D3 only when the adjacent layer has >=30 complete 4h episodes, 4h and 8h signed-return deltas are nonnegative, both bootstrap p05 are >=-0.10 ATR, Early and Late adjacent deltas are nonnegative, and neither LONG nor SHORT 4h/8h median signed return becomes negative. Stop at the first failing layer.

events.BR_PATTERN: frozen v0.3.5 raw breakout-retest pattern events before factor/risk gates
events.TP_PATTERN: frozen v0.3.3 raw trend-pullback pattern events before factor/risk gates

opportunity_layer.controls: for each setup separately, K=5 non-pattern 15m trend-regime decision controls matched on year, regime direction, frozen 15m ATR decile and >=24h separation; deterministic nearest time and control reuse allowed

metrics.max_excursion_atr: max(abs(max future high-reference), abs(min future low-reference))/anchor ATR
metrics.mfe_plus_mae_atr: direction-aware MFE+MAE, algebraically movement magnitude and not direction correctness

opportunity_layer.bootstrap: event plus matched controls cluster, 2000 simulations, seed 36
opportunity_layer.setup_support_rule: at 4h and 8h, future_range_atr, max_excursion_atr and movement>=1.5 deltas are all >0; future_range bootstrap p05 >=-0.05 at both horizons; future_range delta is >0 in Early and Late
opportunity_layer.setup_falsification_rule: future_range_atr, max_excursion_atr and movement>=1.5 deltas are all <=0 at both primary horizons, or future_range bootstrap p95 <=0 at both
opportunity_layer.H18_rule: SUPPORTED if BR_PATTERN or TP_PATTERN satisfies setup support; FALSIFIED if both satisfy setup falsification; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE_MECHANISM; fewer than 30 complete 4h events for both setups yields INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_SAMPLE

H14.statement: The frozen 1h TREND_UP/TREND_DOWN regime contains directional information at regime-episode onset.
H14.sample_gate: at least 100 complete 4h episodes, at least 30 LONG and 30 SHORT, and at least 50 matched-opposite pairs
H14.support: 4h/8h real-minus-permutation and real-minus-matched-opposite signed deltas >0; all four p05 >=-0.05 ATR; LONG and SHORT real signed medians >0 at both horizons; every leave-one-year-out real-minus-permutation delta >0 at 4h/8h; Early and Late real-minus-permutation deltas >0 at both horizons
H14.falsify: real-minus-permutation 4h and 8h point deltas <=0, or both p95 <=0, or real direction signed medians <=0 at both primary horizons

H15.statement: Frozen 4h macro alignment adds directional information within 1h trend episode onsets.
H15.support: 4h/8h signed deltas >0; both p05 >=-0.05; Early/Late deltas nonnegative at both; at least four leave-one-year-out horizon-pairs are positive

H16.statement: Frozen confirmed 15m structure alignment adds directional information within 1h trend episode onsets.

H17.statement: Frozen RSI and/or ROC alignment adds directional information within 1h trend episode onsets.
H17.component_gate: each RSI, ROC and both comparison independently requires 30 complete 4h matched pairs; otherwise that component is INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_SAMPLE
H17.overall: SUPPORTED if the preregistered both-aligned component is SUPPORTED; FALSIFIED if all evaluable components are FALSIFIED; INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_SAMPLE if both-aligned is low sample and no component supports; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE_MECHANISM

H18.statement: Existing TP/BR patterns detect elevated future movement even though they do not provide reliable direction.

final_recommendation.RECOMMEND_DIRECTION_PLUS_OPPORTUNITY_PRO: H14 SUPPORTED, proposed architecture not NONE, Late real direction remains positive, and H18 SUPPORTED
final_recommendation.RECOMMEND_DIRECTION_ONLY_PROTOTYPE: H14 SUPPORTED, proposed architecture not NONE, Late real direction remains positive, and H18 FALSIFIED
final_recommendation.RECOMMEND_NEW_FEATURE_FAMILY_RESEARCH: H14 FALSIFIED or proposed architecture NONE because the frozen price-only Direction foundation has no stable information
